property_summary: For any input that completes without reverting, the reference always returns true; the buggy version returns false, violating the expected return value.
For any input where the call to caddress does not revert, the reference transfer returns true; the mutant returns false.
For any admissible input where the external call sequence completes without revert, the reference transfer should return true, while the mutant returns false.
For any non-empty arrays where the external call sequence completes without revert, the reference transfer always returns true, but the mutant returns false.
For any input that completes without reverting, the return value of transfer is exactly true; the mutant returns false instead, breaking that invariant.
For any admissible input, a successful call to transfer (one that does not revert) must return true; the bug returns false.
For any adversarial call that does not revert, the return value of transfer must match the success of the internal calls; the correct contract returns true while the mutant returns false.
For any admissible input where transfer does not revert, it must return true; the mutant incorrectly returns false even when all internal calls succeed.
For any admissible input where all internal calls succeed and transfer does not revert, the return value must be true; the buggy mutant returns false even when all calls succeed.
For any transfer call that does not revert, the return value must be true; the mutant incorrectly returns false even when all internal calls succeed.
